questions.question: Explain two reasons why Hajj is important for Muslims.

points.text: 1) Hajj unites the ummah — over 2 million Muslims from every country gather in Makkah, wearing identical simple white garments. This removes all distinctions of wealth, race and status, showing that all Muslims are equal before Allah. 2) Hajj brings forgiveness — Muslims believe a properly performed Hajj wipes out all past sins.
